command: echo "== claude-backup plist =="; cat ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.carter.claude-backup.plist; echo; echo "== records PR code =="; grep -rn 'records-log' src | head -6; echo "== deps =="; grep -B2 -A8 '"dependencies"' package.json; echo "== docs listing =="; ls docs | head -40; echo "== cursor state.vscdb =="; ls -la "$HOME/Library/Application Support/Cursor/User/globalStorage/state.vscdb" 2>/dev/null; echo "== gitignore metrics? =="; grep -n 'metrics\|\.approval-journal' .gitignore
